objective: Use the prior stochastic, deterministic, and PDE results to pursue an exact higher-order weakly reversible recurrence/permanence gate. Prioritize all-rate recurrence in a concrete class, rate-box tightness, exact counterexamples, physical holding times, and explicit novelty boundaries.
summary: The complete-pair higher-molecularity family has an internally proved all-fixed-rate physical-time Foster recurrence theorem without the prior strict linear LP. A multiplicative catalyst-free boundary correction gives a common geometric drift and stationary tightness over any compact positive rate box. General higher-dimensional weakly reversible recurrence remains UNKNOWN; no qualifying WR transient/null/explosive example was found.

leaves.question: Recheck exact physical-time Lyapunov control and boundary switches; separate direct linear Foster from the high-order mechanism.
leaves.outcome: Conditional strict-LP Foster theorem and exact generator retained as baseline; no broad recurrence inference.

leaves.question: Audit communicating classes, reachability, rank, and boundary strata for the selected higher-order family.
leaves.outcome: Full lattice is one closed irreducible class; rank r+s; explicit clearing/building paths.

leaves.question: Reconstruct deterministic permanence and keep its quantifiers separate from stochastic recurrence.
leaves.outcome: Published one-linkage WR ODE permanence theorem applies; uniform entry time over unbounded initial states fails; no ODE-to-CTMC inference.

leaves.question: Test reachable boundary-tier failures and distinguish sufficient-condition failure from nonrecurrence.
leaves.outcome: ACK tier inclusion fails on a reachable catalyst-free ray; this is only failure of a sufficient criterion.

leaves.question: Reconstruct complex balance, product form, clocks, and classwise versus uniform stationary conclusions.
leaves.outcome: Exact complex-balance conditions and physical/event clock conversion recorded; product form remains a scoped baseline.

leaves.question: Try adversarial drift and ODE checks without promoting the old sufficient LP to a necessity claim.
leaves.outcome: No counterexample under strict LP; an exact ray only falsifies a weakened drift claim; ODE permanence separate.

leaves.question: Extend exact linear certificates to sparse supports with support-dependent boundary corrections.
leaves.outcome: Sparse paired-edge strict-LP sufficient criterion proved with rational certificates; not complete for recurrence.

leaves.question: Audit primary literature and precise novelty/scope boundaries for the stochastic and ODE claims.
leaves.outcome: General published criteria checked do not cover the whole selected family at arbitrary rates; novelty remains UNKNOWN; N33 and falling-factorial CTMC scopes differ.

leaves.question: Search exact outside-LP recurrent controls and clarify what the LP failure establishes.
leaves.outcome: Complex-balanced recurrent examples outside the LP show non-necessity only; no WR counterexample found.

leaves.question: Test finite boundary-corrector gates and identify where class reducibility obstructs them.
leaves.outcome: Finite gate criterion is exact for its setup; missing immigration examples show reducibility, not transient behavior.

leaves.question: Audit the announced two-species recurrence result and test exact recurrent parameters outside the LP.
leaves.outcome: Detailed-balanced r=s=2 example outside the LP is positive recurrent; broad outside-region classification remains open.

leaves.question: Make the strict small-gain certificate effective and account for exact witness verification costs.
leaves.outcome: Exact primal/dual LP certificate compiler and verifier built; only recognizes its sufficient Foster template.

leaves.question: Check robust rate-box bounds, physical-time safety, and nonexplosion constants.
leaves.outcome: Uniform safety/nonexplosion bounds for the stated certificate region; recurrence only for detailed-balanced subfamily; finite exact smoke check passed.

leaves.question: Derive exact complex-balance constraints, tier behavior, and minimal witnesses for the family.
leaves.outcome: Complex-balance equations and a reachable catalyst-free tier obstruction checked with exact rational arithmetic.

leaves.question: Separate exact LP feasibility and certificate checking from complete recurrence recognition.
leaves.outcome: Strict LP template and Farkas witnesses are effectively checkable; global recurrence decision remains open.

leaves.question: Derive stationary substrate bounds and test rate-boundary implications for biological interpretation.
leaves.outcome: Face-weighted Foster bounds stationary means; rates approaching zero can drive occupancy to zero, outside any one compact positive box.

leaves.question: Seek an all-rate recurrence proof or exact WR escape counterexample beyond the LP; audit sparse support.
leaves.outcome: All-rate exponential Foster theorem for complete pairs, exact LP-infeasible non-CB fixture, and separate sparse support candidate; no qualifying WR counterexample.

leaves.question: Compare primary stochastic-chemistry results with the exact complete-pair family and identify gaps.
leaves.outcome: General d>=3 literature gap retained; two-species all-rate result remains source-reported; product-form covers complex balance only.

leaves.question: Independently audit physical-time nonexplosion and test a route-specific weak-reversibility obstruction.
leaves.outcome: No flaw found in physical-time Foster localization; a periodic channel-word obstruction is narrower than a general explosion theorem.

additional_root_synthesis.claim: Multiplicative boundary correction yields a common geometric drift and stationary tightness on compact positive rate boxes for the complete-pair family.
additional_root_synthesis.scope: Exact generator fixture check only; all-state uniform drift is proved in the report and remains pending independent review.
